posts.en: Heading back to Washington, D.C., from China. It was a Great and Highly Consequential Trip. I will be giving a News Conference tomorrow at 12 P.M., the White House. Also, will be discussing the Trade Deals with Thailand, the Philippines, and others. President DONALD J. TRUMP
posts.zh: 正從中國返回華盛頓特區。這是一次偉大且極具重大意義的訪問。我將於明天中午12點在白宮舉行新聞發布會。此外，我將討論與泰國、菲律賓及其他國家的貿易協議。唐納德·J·川普總統

posts.en: I am now heading to China, from the Philippines, where we had a wonderful meeting on Trade, National Security, and other subjects. I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different Trade Deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark and, in particular, a Deal that will be great for our Farmers and those in the business of "Energy." President Marcos is a powerful leader, and a man of high integrity and substance. It was an Honor to be with him, and his beautiful wife and son. See you in China! President DONALD J. TRUMP
posts.zh: 我現在正從菲律賓前往中國，我們在那裡就貿易、國家安全及其他議題進行了精彩的會談。我很高興地宣布，我們與菲律賓達成了新的、完全不同的貿易協議，這將是一個真正的里程碑，特別是對我們的農民和「能源」行業從業者來說，這將是一項極具意義的協議。馬科斯總統是一位強有力的領導人，也是一位品格高尚、實事求是的人。能與他、他美麗的妻子和兒子在一起，是我的榮幸。中國見！唐納德·J·川普總統

Billions of Dollars is being stolen each and every month. Our Budget could be quickly BALANCED with the correction of this large scale criminal activity. CORRUPTION is in the Democrat Leadership's blood! We don't need a deal with Iran. Those days have long since passed. We've got their money, Hundreds of Bil
posts.zh: 我已要求副總統萬斯將他全部且完全的注意力集中在美國各地由民主黨執政的城市和州所發生的大規模腐敗與犯罪上。像明尼蘇達州、加州、伊利諾州等許多藍州，全都是管理不善、腐敗不堪的災難。每個月都有數十億美元被竊取。只要矯正這種大規模的犯罪行為，我們的預算就能迅速達到平衡。腐敗已深入民主黨領導層的血液！我們不需要與伊朗達成協議。那些日子早已過去。我們已經拿到了他們的錢，數百億……

Huge CARAVANS are forming and beginning their illegal march through Mexico. Many of the people in these Caravans are those that various countries don't want - "Send them to America," they say - But they will not be accepted! MEXICO MUST STOP THEM, NOW, and if they do not do so, the Tariffs on Mexico will be IMMEDIATELY DOUBLED. MEXICO, THE GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, THE VERY LIBERAL NEW GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, OUR GREAT BORDER PATROL, & ICE, HAVE BEEN SO
posts.zh: 我們又來了！隨著共和黨在中期選舉中被認為落敗——我並沒有在選票上——對我們國家的入侵又開始了。龐大的移民隊正在形成，並開始非法穿越墨西哥。這些移民隊中的許多人，是許多國家不想要的人——他們說：「把他們送到美國去」——但他們不會被接受！墨西哥必須立即阻止他們，如果他們不這麼做，對墨西哥的關稅將立即加倍。墨西哥、德州州長、德州那位非常自由派的州長、我們偉大的邊境巡邏隊和移民與海關執法局，一直以來都非常……

posts.en: I am urging all Senators to vote for The American Affordability and Jobs Act (S. 5653)! This Bill is a BIG WIN for U.S. ENERGY INDEPENDENCE and DOMINANCE.This Landmark Permitting Reform Legislation will codify our America First Energy Agenda, and ensure that we can build Pipelines, Mines, and Power Plants faster than ever before, lowering Energy Costs for American Families, and creating High Paying American Jobs.This Legislation also codifies my RATEPAYER PROTECTION PLEDGE, ensuring Data Centers build and pay for their own Electricity, and help invest in their local communities. Remember, Chin
posts.zh: 我敦促所有參議員投票支持《美國可負擔性與就業法案》（S. 5653）！這項法案對美國能源獨立與主導地位是一項重大勝利。這項具有里程碑意義的許可改革立法將把我們的「美國優先」能源議程納入法典，並確保我們能比以往更快地建造管線、礦場和發電廠，降低美國家庭的能源成本，並創造高薪的美國就業機會。這項立法也將我的「費率保護承諾」納入法典，確保數據中心自行建造並支付其電力費用，並協助投資其所在社區。記住，中
